meta.title: Kingdom of Power (KvK) — Kingshot 777
meta.description: Short alliance guide to the Kingshot Kingdom of Power (KvK) event: the phases, the Preparation-week schedule, and what to spend on each stage.

tldr.heading: TL;DR
items: Win Preparation and we can invade the enemy and crown our own High King — two weeks of castle buffs for the whole kingdom.
Save everything and dump it on the matching Preparation day. Spending outside the event window scores nothing.
Battle day: buff up at 10:00 UTC (all 12-hour bonuses + Counter-Recon), defend until 12:00, then commit to the Castle Battle.

phases.heading: The phases
items: Matchmaking (2 days): paired by our top-100 active power — you can't lower it by resetting heroes or troops, so scout the enemy with a spy account.
Preparation (5 days): a double-reward governor race. Win it to avoid invasion and earn the right to invade.
Battle Phase (Sat 10:00–22:00 UTC): points for injuring/killing enemies within 3 Town Center levels of you; Castle Battle runs 12:00–17:00.
Field Triage (~2 days): revive lost troops up to ~90% with gems and alliance help.

spend.heading: What to spend each stage
spend.intro: Bank every item, then spend it on the day where it scores the most points. Read down each day's column to see what to burn — and what to hold back.

legend.best: Best — spend it here for the most points
legend.choice: Choice — also works, but save it for its best day
legend.avoid: Don't — hold it, spending here wastes it

spend.intelNote: Intel Missions: they score on Days 1, 3 and 5 — finish them before ~08:00 UTC on those days. On Days 2 and 4, leave them unfinished so a fresh mission carries over to the next scoring day.

rewards.heading: Rewards
items: Preparation: double the usual Strongest Governor payouts, plus personal and alliance milestones.
Winning Preparation: invasion immunity and the right to crown our High King (two weeks of kingdom buffs).
Battle Phase: personal rewards scaled by the enemy troops you injure and kill.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Scout early. Push a small account in the enemy kingdom to Town Center 8 and read their top players via Mystic Trials.
Coordinate roles. Fill Chief Minister / Noble Advisor each morning and schedule King skills up to 48 hours ahead.
A/B castle strategy vs strong foes. Split our best players across two alliances and counter-rally the moment they hit the castle holder.
Heal constantly so the Infirmary never overflows into the Enlistment Office.
